basic_info.description: This top-floor unit, situated behind a classic Edwardian facade, is ideally located in the lively Mission Dolores neighborhood. 1812 15th St offers two large bedrooms, large closets with mirrored floor-to-ceiling closet doors, and one bathroom. The spacious living and dining areas are bathed in natural light, creating a warm and welcoming environment. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances and ample cabinetry, providing an ideal setup for everyday cooking and entertaining. A private deck off the kitchen and the convenience of in-unit laundry and an intercom system add to the home's appeal. Located near vibrant cafes, restaurants, and shops and with easy access to public transportation, this property's prime location is further enhanced by a high walk and bike score of 95 and a transit score of 100.
